scientific_integrity: Proof based on independent first-hit clocks, gap-order-spacing limits and a truncation argument; checker supplies finite reproducible diagnostics and is not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unit-circle sampling only; joint weak convergence at the first next record; no rate, all-record process, or finite-sample moment convergence asserted. Historical priority not conclusively resolved.
title: The next longest-gap record: a heavy-tailed replacement rank and an explicit drop law
